_comment: The content-pack registry (frontend/modules/contentPacks). Hand-kept: one row per directory under frontend/packs/. The seedling and archipelago packs are GENERATED by scripts/procgen/extract-seedling-art-packs.mjs (whose --check refuses a pack this file does not list); a hand-made pack (a reskin) is added here by hand. `graphics` names the pack stack the Seedling JS runtime page loads for ?graphics=<id>, in override order (a later pack wins per key). `sfx` names the sound-effect stacks the same way (frontend/modules/sfxLibrary), and `music` the music stacks (frontend/modules/musicLibrary).

packs.title: Seedling — the original graphics, sound effects and music
Archipelago — the fork's AP item pickup
